description: Update an existing blog publication's metadata — title, description, domain/routing config, or layout. Only the fields you pass are changed (partial update). Distinct from create_publication (which creates a new one). publicationId comes from list_publications or list_blogs.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

domainId.description: Custom domain ID to route this publication under

publicationId.description: Blog publication ID (from list_publications or list_blogs)

name: update_publication
